import_story.title: SO-MIRROR File
import_story.description: v2.6 plan 01, G-L1 U6 without a model: in FILE gating mode the memory mirror creates this chat's own lorebook only once a mirrorable (relationship) fact exists, lists and binds it, and the keyword scan activates its entry.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugSceneSummaryResponse = 'The party entered the moonlit hall and found a brass statue by the stairs.'; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const mode = rt.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo?.gatingMode ?? 'file'; if (mode !== 'file') throw new Error('U6 is the FILE-mode leg, the install runs gating mode ' + mode); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const chatId = ctx.getCurrentChatId(); const name = `Story Orchestrator - SO-MIRROR File - ${chatId}`; if ((ctx.getWorldInfoNames?.() ?? []).includes(name)) throw new Error('the mirror book already exists'); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info) throw new Error('the fresh chat already has a chat lorebook: ' + ctx.chatMetadata.world_info); if (rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook) throw new Error('fresh chat already owns a mirror book'); globalThis.__soMirrorFile = { chatId, name }; return { mode, chatId, name };

steps.send: We step into the moonlit hall. Arin swears to watch my back and keeps a silver bell tied to his belt.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const to = ctx.chat.length - 1; await rt.runSceneBreakPass({ id: 'mirror-file-scene', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'scene:location', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: 0, to }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [], sceneBreak: { at: to, reason: 'location' } }); const scenes = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => entry.tier === 'scene_history'); if (!scenes.length) throw new Error('the mocked scene summary never landed'); const wiBook = rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook; if (wiBook) throw new Error('a scene row created the mirror book, but scene rows are not mirrored: ' + JSON.stringify(wiBook)); const sync = await rt.syncWorldInfo(); if (sync.skipped !== 'nothing-live' || sync.ran) throw new Error('a scene-only memory must skip the mirror as nothing-live: ' + JSON.stringify(sync)); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info) throw new Error('the chat slot was bound with nothing to mirror: ' + ctx.chatMetadata.world_info); return { scenes: scenes.length, sync };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const { chatId, name } = globalThis.__soMirrorFile; const at = ctx.chat.length - 1; await rt.applyExtractionAudit({ id: 'mirror-file-seed', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'manual', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: at, to: at }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }, [], [{ tier: 'facts', type: 'relationship', importance: 2, expiration: 'permanent', entities: ['Arin'], text: 'Arin has sworn an oath to guard Max, and keeps a silver bell tied to his belt as its token.', evidence: 'Arin swears to watch my back' }]); const live = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => entry.type === 'relationship'); if (!live.length) throw new Error('the seeded relationship fact never landed: ' + JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.map((e) => [e.tier, e.type, e.text]))); const first = await rt.syncWorldInfo(); if (first.lorebook !== name || first.created < 1 || first.binding !== 'bound') throw new Error('expected the book adopted, one entry and a fresh bind: ' + JSON.stringify(first)); const wiBook = rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook; if (wiBook?.name !== name || wiBook?.chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the chat did not record its mirror book: ' + JSON.stringify(wiBook)); if (!ctx.getWorldInfoNames().includes(name)) throw new Error('not in world_names without a reload'); const picker = [...document.querySelectorAll('#world_info option')].some((o) => o.textContent === name); const editor = [...document.querySelectorAll('#world_editor_select option')].some((o) => o.textContent === name); if (!picker || !editor) throw new Error(`missing from the pickers: global=${picker} editor=${editor}`); if (!rt.getProvisioningEnvironment().lorebookNames.includes(name)) throw new Error('listAllLorebooks does not see it'); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info !== name) throw new Error('not bound to the chat: ' + ctx.chatMetadata.world_info); const server = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }) }).then((r) => r.json()); const comments = Object.values(server.entries ?? {}).map((e) => e.comment); if (!comments.some((c) => String(c).startsWith('so_'))) throw new Error('the server file holds no mirrored entry: ' + JSON.stringify(comments)); return { first, comments };

const second = await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.syncWorldInfo(); if (second.created || second.updated || second.disabled || second.binding !== null) throw new Error('a second sync was not a no-op: ' + JSON.stringify(second)); return second;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const { name } = globalThis.__soMirrorFile; const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const lines = ctx.chat.filter((m) => !m.is_system).map((m) => `${m.name}: ${m.mes}`).reverse(); const scan = await wi.checkWorldInfo(lines, 8192, true); const fromMirror = [...scan.allActivatedEntries.values()].filter((entry) => entry.world === name).map((entry) => ({ comment: entry.comment, key: entry.key })); if (!fromMirror.length) throw new Error('the keyword scan did not activate the mirror entry: ' + JSON.stringify([...scan.allActivatedEntries.values()].map((e) => [e.world, e.comment]))); return { activated: fromMirror };
